import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

from collections import deque
def f(g):
    bg=g[0][0]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]==bg or seen[i][j]: continue
            c=g[i][j]
            q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
            while q:
                a,b=q.popleft(); cells.append((a,b))
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    x,y=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==c:
                        seen[x][y]=True; q.append((x,y))
            rs=[p[0] for p in cells]; cs=[p[1] for p in cells]
            r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
            inter=set(p for p in cells if r0<p[0]<r1 and c0<p[1]<c1)
            for a,b in inter: out[a][b]=2
    return out

for k in ['Demo pair 1 input','Demo pair 1 output']:
    pass
print(f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
